create_sumsegmenttree: create a SumSegmentTree instance with a given size and float32 or float64 dtype
update_segment_tree_value: update a value at a specific index in the SumSegmentTree with an optional mask
query_segment_tree_range: query the sum of values in a range [l, r] from the SumSegmentTree
scan_lower_bound_segment_tree: scan for the lower bound index where cumulative sum reaches a given value
get_segment_tree_at_index: get the value stored at a specific index using the at method or bracket access
